author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000034466 
GO:0006535 L-cysteine biosynthetic process from L-serine
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
All mammals (example: CBS human)
Cbs (Dmel Q9VRD9)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

There is a confusion in the usage of the following GO terms for annotation:
L-cysteine biosynthetic process via L-cystathionine
L-cysteine biosynthetic process from L-serine

These 2 terms cover 2 different pathways: 

**L-cysteine biosynthetic process via L-cystathionine**
use both L-serine and L-cystathionine as starting material ([HOMOCYSDEGR-PWY](https://biocyc.org/pathway?orgid=META&id=HOMOCYSDEGR-PWY))
used by vertebrates, Dmel etc..

**L-cysteine biosynthetic process from L-serine**
start with L-serine ([CYSTSYN-PWY](https://biocyc.org/pathway?orgid=META&id=CYSTSYN-PWY))
found mainly in E.coli and plants, yeast, C.elegans

These are the experimental annotations that I changed that are behind the rule:
P32582 · CBS_YEAST sent request for the change
Q2V0C9 · CBS_APIME change DONE
title: PAINT issue: erroneous propagation of PTN000034466 L-cysteine biosynthetic process from L-serine

author: marcfeuermann
body: Indeed, primary annotations were confusing. Changes done.
